Inbound from content/marketing tools comparison article.
Lead: VP Product (Maya Singh) - building a multi-tenant SaaS for marketing teams (templates + bulk generation).

Security: needs SSO (SAML) and audit logs; no on-prem requirement today (public cloud ok).
Quotes: "We can tolerate slightly lower quality for mass content if it halves the cost."

use_case_summary: Primarily bulk marketing content generation: ad copy, landing page variants, social posts, subject lines. Workload is high QPS with short prompts and large fan-out (many variations). Cost-sensitive; interested in automatic prefix/KV caching, request batching, and model fallback to cheaper variants for non-critical outputs. Requires hosted API self-serve but will evaluate SLA/volume pricing if costs/latency acceptable. Security: SAML SSO + audit logging required for procurement.
